meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 x_search 工具搜 X(Twitter)帖子:给时效性查询加日期范围、限定可信账号、用 since:/from: 等运算符写查询、拆成 2-3 次独立搜索,再把结果与 web_search 对照,并逐条引用 x.com 链接。
howto.when: 当你提到 X search、Twitter search、tweets 等词,或想知道 X 上大家在说什么、看社交信号时触发;前提是已连接 xAI 账号,x_search 才会注册。

say.text: 帮我搜一下 X 上最近关于英伟达的帖子
say.note: 会按最近一天起搜,必要时放宽到七天

say.text: 只看 @growth_papa 这些账号发的财报推文
say.note: 会以限定账号方式单独搜一遍

say.text: 把 X 上的说法和网页搜索结果对照一下
say.note: 会同时跑 web_search 并说明是否一致

howto.what_en: Claude uses the x_search tool to search X/Twitter posts: date-bounding time-sensitive queries, scoping trusted accounts, using since:/from: operators, splitting into 2-3 searches, reconciling with web_search, and citing x.com URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like X search, Twitter search, or tweets, or when you want to know what people are saying on X or check social signal. Needs a connected xAI account for x_search to register.

say_en.text: Search X for recent posts about Nvidia
say_en.note: Runs a date-bounded recent search and cites x.com links

say_en.text: Only show tweets about earnings from @growth_papa
say_en.note: Runs a separate pass scoped to those handles

say_en.text: Compare what X says with web search results
say_en.note: Also runs web_search and reports agreement
